page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.small is an entry-level compute-optimized instance built on the ARM64 architecture and powered by a dedicated 2.75 GHz Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor. It features 1 physical core and 1 virtual CPU, paired with 2.0 GB of memory, yielding a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio. Cache allocation includes 64 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and 64 MB L3 cache. The instance includes hardware AES acceleration but lacks x86-specific vector extensions. It provides 1 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no bundled local storage, and operates under a KVM hypervisor.

In single-threaded benchmark evaluations, the Yitian YiTian710 core delivers average performance, recording 1773.69 in stress-ng single-core tests, 27.84 GB/sec in gzip compression, and 10.24 GB/sec in bzip3 decompression. However, overall system and multi-core benchmarks show clear performance boundaries due to single-vCPU limits. Multi-core stress-ng, PassMark CPU (836.56), and PassMark memory (936.23) fall into the bottom percentile tier. Memory bandwidth achieves 18.96 GB/sec for large block reads and 7.51 GB/sec for writes. Application-level throughput yields 1.53 million Redis SET operations per second and 1.67 GB/sec for static web serving.

The instance offers a cost-effective entry point for lightweight compute requirements by providing a dedicated ARM core without shared CPU throttling. The primary tradeoffs stem from low overall memory capacity, absence of local SSD storage, and restricted multi-threaded capability. Consequently, high-concurrency applications, memory-intensive databases, or large-scale data processing tasks are constrained on this hardware size. The ecs.c8y.small instance is best suited for lightweight web microservices, basic API endpoints, low-traffic utility nodes, continuous integration workers, or small ARM platform validation tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.small is a lightweight compute-optimized server instance powered by a single dedicated 2.75 GHz Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 ARM64 processor core and 2.0 GB of memory. It features 64 MB L3 cache, hardware AES support, a 1 Gbps network baseline, and zero local storage. Single-threaded benchmarks reveal solid baseline performance, achieving 1773.69 in stress-ng single-core and 27.84 GB/sec in gzip compression. However, multi-core throughput and memory bandwidth fall into lower performance tiers due to resource limitations. The single-core compute profile and low memory footprint make this instance cost-efficient for lightweight utility roles rather than high-concurrency workloads. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c8y.small is well suited for lightweight web serving, API endpoints, microservices, and ARM build testing.
